map.选择四对纲领的证候特征，自动推导演绎八纲辨证结果（表里·寒热·虚实·阴阳）: Select the pattern features of the four pairs of principles to automatically derive the result of eight-principle differentiation (exterior/interior · cold/heat · deficiency/excess · yin/yang)
map.八纲以四对纲领交叉定证：表里定病位、寒热定病性、虚实定邪正盛衰、阴阳为总纲（表、: The eight principles cross-determine patterns with four pairs: exterior/interior locates the disease position, cold/heat determines the nature, deficiency/excess weighs pathogen against healthy qi, and yin/yang is the overarching principle (exterior, heat and excess are yang; interior, cold and deficiency are yin). After judging each pair item by item and combining them, such as an exterior-cold excess pattern or an interior-deficiency heat pattern, the remaining six principles yield the overall yin/yang attribute, which determines the treatment principle such as releasing the exterior, warming the interior, clearing heat or tonifying deficiency.
map.一、表里（辨病位深浅）: I. Exterior / Interior (locating the depth of the disease)
map.二、寒热（辨疾病性质）: II. Cold / Heat (locating the nature of the disease)
map.三、虚实（辨邪正盛衰）: III. Deficiency / Excess (weighing pathogen against healthy qi)
map.选择各纲特征后点击「辨证推演」: After selecting the features of each principle, click "Derive the pattern"
map.💡 阴阳是八纲的总纲：表、热、实属阳，里、寒、虚属阴。临床辨证时，表里寒热虚实常: 💡 Yin and yang are the overarching principle of the eight principles: exterior, heat and excess are yang, while interior, cold and deficiency are yin. Clinically, exterior, interior, cold, heat, deficiency and excess often interleave, so the primary versus secondary and true versus false aspects must be distinguished.

map.里＋热＋实→「里实热证：清热泻火/通腑，白虎汤、承气类」；半表半里→小柴胡汤和解: Interior + heat + excess → "interior excess heat pattern: clear heat, drain fire and purge fu organs, with Bai Hu Tang and Cheng Qi type formulas"; half-exterior half-interior uses Xiao Chai Hu Tang to harmonise.
